case.title: Where is my booking page link
case.text: Hi where can I find the link to my booking page? I want to put it on my Instagram
case.why: Short, common how-to; ideal candidate for a ready-to-approve reply.

output.reply:
Hi Ayesha! You can find your booking page link in Settings → Booking Page → Share. Copy the link from there and paste it into your Instagram bio.

A few tips:
- Make sure Publish booking page is turned on in Settings → Booking Page, so clients can use the link.
- Your link looks like book.slotwise.test/your-business. If you change the page address under Page link, old links stop working, so update your Instagram bio if you do.
- Services only appear on the page if they have at least one staff member assigned.

Let us know if you need any more help!
